mode.title: Mode
mode.description: backfill: rebuild the baseline for a date range. daily: add yesterday to the baseline (schedule once a day). news: sweep MarketWatch and Yahoo news only (schedule every 2 hours, the feeds are rolling windows). live: D-day snapshot of the last N minutes across every platform (schedule every 10 minutes).

dateFrom.title: From date (UTC)
dateFrom.description: First day to collect in backfill or daily mode, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to 2026-11-05 for backfill and yesterday for daily.

dateTo.title: To date (UTC)
dateTo.description: Last day to collect, inclusive, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to yesterday.

xQuery.title: X search query
xQuery.description: One X advanced-search query. The Actor adds since:/until: per day.
xQuery.default: ("Anthropic IPO" OR "$ANT" OR "Anthropic stock" OR "Anthropic valuation" OR "Anthropic shares") -filter:retweets

searchQueries.title: LinkedIn and YouTube search terms
searchQueries.description: Search terms passed to the LinkedIn and YouTube Actors.

liveTicker.title: Main ticker
liveTicker.description: The ticker the tracker is about. Use another listed ticker (for example NVDA) to rehearse D-day.

peerTickers.title: Peer tickers
peerTickers.description: Quoted next to the main ticker and used to find Anthropic stories on Yahoo Finance.

llmModel.title: Sentiment model (OpenRouter)
llmModel.description: Model id used through the Apify OpenRouter Actor to score each post.

maxXPagesPerDay.title: Max X pages per day
maxXPagesPerDay.description: About 20 tweets per page at $0.004 per page. When the limit is hit, that day's X volume is flagged as a floor.

maxLinkedInPostsPerQuery.title: Max LinkedIn posts per query per day
maxLinkedInPostsPerQuery.description: Multiplied by the number of days in the range.

maxYouTubeVideosPerQuery.title: Max YouTube videos per query per day
maxYouTubeVideosPerQuery.description: Multiplied by the number of days in the range (up to 4).

liveWindowMinutes.title: Live window (minutes)
liveWindowMinutes.description: In live mode, how far back the snapshot looks.

storeName.title: Storage name
storeName.description: Name of the key-value store (and the <name>-posts dataset) the website reads.
